# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"
wd_mrna  <- "F:/wd/Mm_Bulk_RNA-seq"

tissues <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

# Tissue order for chord diagram sectors (grouped anatomically)
custom_tissue_order <- c("bat", "ewat", "iwat", "liver", "gas", "sol", "gut", "hypo", "panc")

# The mRNA GLM cluster split (A/B/C/D) is intentionally NOT used here:
# each tissue is a single target sector.

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "03.0.1_circus_no_mRNA_cluster", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory:", dir_output, "\n")
```

# 3. Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Return the path to the latest negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv.
# Both the union-only pipeline (02.0.2) and the original one (02) write the same
# file; the newer directory is searched first.
find_union_pairs_csv <- function() {
  bases <- c(
    file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "02.0.2_integration_union"),
    file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "02_integration")
  )
  for (base in bases) {
    if (!dir.exists(base)) next
    all_dated <- sort(list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE),
                      decreasing = TRUE)
    for (d in all_dated) {
      f <- file.path(d, "union", "negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv")
      if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
    }
  }
  stop("negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv not found under ",
       paste(bases, collapse = " or "))
}
```

# 4. Load union negative pairs

```{r load_pairs}
union_csv <- find_union_pairs_csv()
cat("Using:", union_csv, "\n")

neg_union <- read.csv(union_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Union negative pairs loaded:", nrow(neg_union), "rows\n")
cat("Tissues present:", paste(sort(unique(neg_union$tissue)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(head(neg_union))
```

# 5. Build chord summary

```{r chord_data}
# Gene count per tissue sector (unique mRNA genes)
gene_counts <- neg_union %>%
  distinct(tissue, SYMBOL) %>%
  count(tissue, name = "n_genes")

cat("Genes per tissue sector:\n")
print(as.data.frame(gene_counts))

# Display label lookup: tissue -> "liver (45)"
# Tissue name is also shown on the outer arc, so the inner track carries the count
sector_label_lookup <- gene_counts %>%
  mutate(display_label = paste0("(", n_genes, ")")) %>%
  dplyr::select(tissue, display_label) %>%
  deframe()

# Chord summary.
# Ribbon weight = number of distinct target genes for that miRNA in that tissue.
# (In the cluster-split version each miRNA-cluster link carried weight 1; with the
#  cluster split removed, the gene count is the equivalent aggregation.)
chord_summary <- neg_union %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, tissue, SYMBOL) %>%
  count(miRNA_Name, tissue, name = "value") %>%
  dplyr::rename(from = miRNA_Name, to = tissue)

miRNA_cluster_map <- neg_union %>%
  distinct(from = miRNA_Name, miRNA_cluster) %>%
  mutate(Plasma = paste0("miRNA_clust", miRNA_cluster)) %>%
  dplyr::select(from, Plasma)

chord_summary <- chord_summary %>%
  left_join(miRNA_cluster_map, by = "from")

cat("\nChord summary:\n")
cat("  miRNA sectors :", n_distinct(chord_summary$from), "\n")
cat("  Target sectors:", n_distinct(chord_summary$to),   "\n")
cat("  Total links   :", nrow(chord_summary),             "\n")
cat("  Total weight  :", sum(chord_summary$value),        "\n")
```

# 6. Color setup

```{r colors}
# miRNA cluster colors
cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD",
  "2" = "#FDCDAC",
  "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4",
  "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

# Plasma column is "miRNA_clust1" etc.; strip prefix to look up by cluster number
miRNA_colors <- chord_summary %>%
  distinct(from, Plasma) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Plasma)) %>%
  mutate(
    clust_num = sub("miRNA_clust", "", Plasma),
    color     = cluster_colors[clust_num]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(from, color) %>%
  deframe()

# Tissue arc colors (Pastel1 palette for the outer arc)
tissue_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(n = max(3, length(custom_tissue_order)), name = "Pastel1")[
    seq_along(custom_tissue_order)],
  custom_tissue_order
)

# Target sectors are tissues, so the grid color is simply the tissue color
all_target_sectors <- unique(chord_summary$to)
target_grid_colors <- tissue_colors[all_target_sectors]

cat("target_grid_colors:\n")
print(target_grid_colors)

grid.col <- c(miRNA_colors, target_grid_colors)
```

# 7. Sector ordering

```{r ordering}
# miRNA sectors: sorted by cluster label, then alphabetically
sorted_miRNAs <- chord_summary %>%
  distinct(from, Plasma) %>%
  arrange(Plasma, from) %>%
  pull(from)

# Target sectors: one per tissue, in custom_tissue_order
sorted_targets <- custom_tissue_order[custom_tissue_order %in% all_target_sectors]

sector_order <- c(sorted_miRNAs, sorted_targets)

# Validate
missing_sectors <- setdiff(unique(c(chord_summary$from, chord_summary$to)), sector_order)
if (length(missing_sectors) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: missing from sector_order:", paste(missing_sectors, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("All sectors accounted for.\n")
}
```

# 8. Circus plot (inline)

```{r chord_diagram, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
draw_circus <- function() {

  circos.clear()
  circos.par(
    cell.padding = c(0.01, 0.01, 0, 0),
    track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01),
    canvas.xlim  = c(-1.7, 1.7),   # wider canvas to accommodate outer labels
    canvas.ylim  = c(-1.7, 1.7)
  )

  chordDiagram(
    chord_summary,
    grid.col          = grid.col,
    order             = sector_order,
    transparency      = 0.3,
    directional       = 1,
    annotationTrack   = "grid",
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.10)   # track for miRNA names + gene counts
  )

  # Track 1: miRNA names (clockwise) + gene count for each tissue sector
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    panel.fun   = function(x, y) {
      si <- CELL_META$sector.index
      if (si %in% sorted_miRNAs) {
        circos.text(
          CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1],
          # Drop the "mmu-" species prefix from the displayed miRNA name.
          # Sector ids keep the full name, so ordering and colors are unaffected.
          sub("^mmu-", "", si),
          facing     = "clockwise",
          niceFacing = TRUE,
          adj        = c(0, 0.5),
          cex        = 1.0,
          font       = 2
        )
      } else if (si %in% sorted_targets) {
        lbl <- sector_label_lookup[si]
        if (!is.na(lbl)) {
          circos.text(
            CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1],
            lbl,
            facing     = "clockwise",
            niceFacing = TRUE,
            adj        = c(0, 0.5),
            cex        = 0.7,
            font       = 1
          )
        }
      }
    },
    bg.border = NA
  )

  # Outer layers: colored tissue arc + tissue name text.
  # One sector per tissue, so each arc spans exactly its own sector.
  for (tis in sorted_targets) {

    col <- tissue_colors[[tis]]

    start_deg <- get.cell.meta.data("cell.start.degree", sector.index = tis)
    end_deg   <- get.cell.meta.data("cell.end.degree",   sector.index = tis)
    mid_deg   <- (start_deg + end_deg) / 2
    mid_rad   <- mid_deg * pi / 180
    srt       <- mid_deg - 90
    if (mid_deg < -90 || mid_deg > 90) srt <- srt + 180

    # Layer 1: thin colored arc (just outside the sector grid at r ~ 1.0)
    draw.sector(
      start.degree = start_deg,
      end.degree   = end_deg,
      rou1         = 1.01,
      rou2         = 1.07,
      col          = col,
      border       = NA
    )

    # Layer 2: tissue name text (outermost, bold)
    text(
      x      = 1.22 * cos(mid_rad),
      y      = 1.22 * sin(mid_rad),
      labels = tis,
      cex    = 0.85,
      font   = 2,
      srt    = srt,
      adj    = c(0.5, 0.5)
    )
  }

  # Legend: miRNA clusters only (the mRNA GLM cluster legend is not applicable)
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = names(cluster_colors),
         fill   = cluster_colors,
         title  = "miRNA Clusters",
         border = NA, cex = 1.2, text.font = 2)
}

draw_circus()
```

# 9. Save SVG

```{r save_svg}
svg_out <- file.path(dir_output, "circus_union_negative_pairs_no_mRNA_cluster.svg")
svg(svg_out, width = 12, height = 12)
draw_circus()
dev.off()
circos.clear()

cat("Saved:", svg_out, "\n")
```
